facts.fact: Le Matin, citing a parliamentary report, says no centralised state body can regulate AI in public action, and that algorithms are being installed without ethical safeguards defined nationally.

MAR.note: Document states nothing on this question for the country.

facts.fact: Le Matin, citing a parliamentary working group report, says an AI system for school support management is deployed in the Draa-Tafilalet Academy, using the Massar, SAGE+ and GEXA+ databases to predict pupil performance and flag dropout risk.

MAR.note: Document states nothing on this question for the country.
